acceptance: Every factory component, external tube terminal, winding end, switch contact and return has a source-backed connection or an explicit manufacturer option.

source.figure: PT-42/PT-44 schematic and under-chassis location view

blocking_reconciliation.evidence: The Philco p.38 drawing shows two opposite winding ends. The upper conductor approaches the 7A8 oscillator-anode glyph; the lower passes a network of crossings and #13/IF conductors. The four-dot contact marks and exact winding aliases require an independent continuity check before graph promotion.
blocking_reconciliation.required_resolution: Trace each right-hand winding end to a numbered 7A8 pin and the correct supply/return group; verify crossings and the #13/IF conductor assignments against a legible alternate schematic or original chassis continuity measurements.
blocking_reconciliation.do_not_infer: Do not assign winding polarity, physical lugs, inductance, or a crossing as a junction from page proximity.

blocking_reconciliation.evidence: Enlargement of Philco p.38 places #13 beside the right-hand oscillator winding and several crossing conductors; the prior v0.40 claim that #13:a is the 7B7 grid node and #13:b is B− must be independently reverified before using it to close the oscillator path.
blocking_reconciliation.required_resolution: Follow #12 secondary and both #13 ends through every crossing in an independent scan or with continuity testing; amend the prior graph and audit if its assignments are contradicted.

blocking_reconciliation.area: External tube pins and internal/no-connection roles
blocking_reconciliation.required_resolution: Classify each omitted socket position as externally wired, internal-only, or no connection using manufacturer basing and Philco p.38; crosswalk both diode plates and their returns without assigning an unnumbered glyph by guesswork.

blocking_reconciliation.area: Physical line switch and chassis return
blocking_reconciliation.required_resolution: Correlate #16 switch terminals and physical socket leads to a clear original chassis underside or continuity record; retain AC plug A/B aliases because the factory diagram does not polarize the plug. Keep chassis distinct from B− unless a source establishes the relation.

preferred_new_evidence: Philco PT-42/PT-44 Service Bulletin 365 schematic and under-chassis views
Rider 12-45 high-resolution schematic and socket layout
Clear original PT-42/PT-44 underside photos around #10, 7A8, #12/#13, and 7C6 with continuity readings
